preregistration.label: fix-round preregistration, written after the independent review and before any fix-round rerun
preregistration.expectation: Rerunning the frozen 30-case held-out set with a provider that prints only its prediction (no label) and an assertion that reads the label from the test's own vars reproduces 26/30 (deterministic embeddings); a constant-prediction control provider scores near chance, proving the assertion can fail.
preregistration.criteria: sha256 of cases.json recorded before the run; provider output contains no label; assertion compares to vars.label; 30 per-case gradingResults retained; control run pass count <= 12/30; generator script retained under blueprints/.

fixround2_preregistration.label: fix-round-2 preregistration, written after the second independent review (Opus) and before any fix-round-2 command
fixround2_preregistration.expectation: (a) The model card's call (separate requests; queries with input_type 'query', candidates with input_type 'document', as in the retained upstream-example.py) on the frozen 30-case easy set scores at least 28/30 through promptfoo; if the round-1 failures (case-07/09/13/24) persist, the harness-setup explanation is rejected and reported. (b) A new 30-case hard-negative set (query, one correct passage, three same-topic distractors that share vocabulary but do not answer) is authored by one Codex call (read-only, ephemeral, user config and hooks disabled, --output-schema), not by this agent, and frozen by sha256 and committed before any embedding call. (c) promptfoo eval on the hard set runs two models: Nemotron-3-Embed-1B (model-card input_type call) and BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fastembed, pinned version, model-card query instruction); each retains 30 per-case gradingResults. Both models are expected to score lower on the hard set than Nemotron on the easy set. A constant pred=0 control on the hard set passes exactly the label-0 cases. A diagnostic untyped Nemotron run on the hard set is also recorded.
fixround2_preregistration.criteria: settled only if arms (a), (b) and (c) all execute with per-case scores retained, the hard set is frozen and committed before any model call on it, the case author is not this agent, and the control passes only label-0 cases. The shared predict() used by gap 4 is left unchanged; the typed call is a separate function. If any arm fails to run, the outcome is advanced with the remaining arm named. Label correctness of the Codex-authored set is reviewed by this agent only for schema and duplicate checks, not re-labelled; that limit is disclosed.

limits: The hard set was written by one Codex call, not by a human or a published benchmark. This agent checked only schema, counts and distinct queries, and read the two bge-failure cases (their labels are correct on inspection); the other labels were not re-reviewed. Nemotron reaches the ceiling on both sets, so the hard set cannot separate it from a stronger model; the 30 vs 28 difference against bge-small is two cases on one deterministic run, not a ranking with confidence. bge-small ran through fastembed 0.8.1, which serves Qdrant's quantised ONNX export (model_optimized.onnx sha256 51f1bd0a..., setup/bge-model-files.sha256), not the original FP32 weights. The fix-round-1 26/30 (and the gap-4 harness comparison built on it) used a call without input_type that drops Nemotron to 13/30 on the hard set; it measured the harness call, not model quality. Round-1 note: the round-1 assertion read the label from the provider's own output; that design was replaced in fix round 1 and is superseded (commit b37df23).
